title: macrozamia tridentata f. oblongifolia
intro: Macrozamia tridentata f. oblongifolia, commonly known as the Queensland cycad or Queensland umbrella tree, is a variant of the cycad plant species. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Macrozamia tridentata f. oblongifolia include analgesic, antipyretic, and diuretic effects, which help in relieving pain, reducing fever, and increasing urine production. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
